text: わしの　ポケモンは　すべてを　ほのおで　やいて　こがしまくる　つわもの　ばかり　なのだー！

structure.jp: わしの　ポケモンは
すべてを　ほのおで　やいて　こがしまくる
structure.en: that burn and scorch everything with flames like mad

structure.jp: つわもの　ばかり　なのだー！

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる stuck on a verb says it is done wildly, over and over, without holding back. こがしまくる = 'scorches like mad'.

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a thing says there is nothing but that. つわもの　ばかり = 'nothing but tough ones'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ (なのだ after a thing) at the end gives the sentence a strong 'that's how it is' feeling, here shouted with a stretched だ. つわもの　ばかり　なのだー = 'they are all tough ones, you see!'
